title: Global Markets Brief — 20 Nov 2026
intro: Global markets are enduring a severe risk-off wave during the Asian session, driven by broad-based equity liquidations and plunging precious metals. The VIX has surged 15.80% to 28.44 as panic selling grips indices from Wall Street to Tokyo.

sections.heading: Today's calendar (CET)
sections.content:

- 🟠 16:00 · USD Revised UoM Inflation Expectations · (f · · p 4.3%)

sections.heading: 🌍 Macro tone
sections.content: Market sentiment is aggressively risk-off as a cocktail of short-seller attacks on key tech names and intensifying macroeconomic anxiety hammers risk assets globally. Asian equities are bleeding led by the Nikkei 225 down 5.06%, while US futures point to an extension of the prior session's steep losses.

sections.heading: 🛢 Oil desk
sections.content: WTI crude trades higher at 82.90, up 0.56% on the day despite a weekly dip, while Brent crude has slipped 2.28% to 89.88, narrowing the Brent-WTI spread to 6.98. Energy markets are reacting to conflicting pressures from Walmart noting soaring fuel costs against broader macro-driven commodity liquidation.

sections.heading: Cross-asset read
sections.content: US Treasury yields are subdued with the 10Y down 1.4bp at 5.052% and the 30Y down 1.1bp at 5.401%, offering little shelter as the DXY edges down 0.17% to 103.72. Equities are down precipitously across every major region and commodities are suffering aggressive long liquidation, led by gold dropping 3.43% to 3,559.10 and silver plunging 5.13% to 42.05.

sections.heading: Potential scenarios
sections.content:
- *▲ Bullish · VIX — above 28.50 opens 30.50 · invalid below 27.00*
Spiking fear metrics as equity liquidations accelerate across global boardrooms.
- *▼ Bearish · Nikkei 225 — below 56,400 opens 54,000 · invalid above 58,000*
Heavy regional selling pressure dragging Asian benchmarks deep into the red.
- *▼ Bearish · Gold — below 3,550.00 opens 3,400.00 · invalid above 3,650.00*
Broad liquidation forcing liquid asset sales across precious metals.
- *▲ Bullish · WTI — above 83.00 opens 86.00 · invalid below 81.00*
Resilient crude outperformance relative to plunging industrial metals.

sections.heading: Key risks
sections.content:
- Contagion from aggressive tech sector short-seller reports spilling over into broader equity indices.
- Uncontrolled margin-driven liquidation across commodities amplifying safe-haven liquidity demand.
